title: Dreame L50 Ultra Robotic Vacuum and Mop $676.80 (Appliance Trade-In Required) + Delivery / $0 C&C @ Harvey Norman
body:
Deal: Dreame L50 Ultra Robotic Vacuum and Mop $676.80 (Appliance Trade-In Required) + Delivery / $0 C&C @ Harvey Norman

[CheapCookie] Excellent price.
I would jump on it if I didn't have the AE model.
[rbrbrb] So just have to trade in any small appliance for this price? Eg old nutribullet?
[hollykryten] Yes you do need to trade in to obtain the $676.8 price. 20% off (with promo code EXTRA20) the $996 is $796.80 and then the further $120 off (trade in) gives the final price of $676.80.
But if you don't have any thing to trade in then you can just get the $796.80 price using the 20% off promo coupon code.
[bheart] I could not tell which appliances are eligible for trade in and under what condition
[hollykryten] This is just what it says for the trade in T&C. It makes no mention of what appliance you can trade in. How confusing. Maybe it's an old vacuum cleaner that needs to be traded in. But i'm just guessing here.
"Save $120 when you upgrade to this new Small Electrical Appliance
Trade-in promotion valid from 23 July 2026 to 11:59PM AEST 2 August 2026. Final discounted price is applied in cart. The trade-in discount entitles the customer to receive the indicated trade-in value from the ticketed price of selected products purchased from a franchise during the promotional offer. The trade-in provided by the customer becomes the property of the franchise once the goods are collected/delivered to the franchise originating the sale and will be disposed of accordingly. The return of the trade-in product may not be possible if the franchise has already disposed of the goods. The franchise reserves the right not to collect the trade-in goods offered if, in the reasonable opinion of the collector, the goods offered will be dangerous and/or hazardous to collect. Terms and conditions apply. See in store for details."
[Wigles] I ordered already but didnt even see i had to trade in until i saw this comment haha
[hollykryten] Well if you have nothing to trade in then you won't get the extra $120 off. You probably have to trade in your old vacuum cleaner is my guess. But if you selected trade in i reckon you'll be asked to bring in your eligible trade in item into the store. No trade in item then no final discount.
[overule] The trade in has to be highlighted on the title. I nearly bought this and i have nothing to trade.
[hollykryten] Yes it makes it seem to every one that the $676.80 is the normal sale price. The title makes no mention of trade in required. The description doesn't mention trade in needed either. It just says in the description a $120 off at checkout, not mentioning at all that's for a trade in. It's rather badly written. But then it's the OP's first post.
[Sr1993e] I think just 2000pa more and the flex side brush, not gonna deal with returns and buying it lol I got it from Amazon after returning a year old eureka J12 that apparently hasnt been cleaning itself for the whole year lol

[muzzy1907] Recently ordered the L10s ultra gen2 from the Amazon deal which is on its way. Did a quick AI check and came back with this..
Paying an extra $260 for the L50 Ultra is only worth it if you have a larger home, more carpets, thresholds, or pets. For most homes, the L10s Ultra Gen 2 is the better value because it already has 10,000Pa suction, mop extension, self-emptying, and self-washing/drying, while the L50 Ultra mainly adds premium navigation, much stronger carpet/obstacle handling, and threshold climbing.
